description:
Termodinamica SW 108-01 Wiring Schematic - a marine inverter air conditioning system general arrangement/wiring diagram showing two parallel BUS network systems (Port and Starboard) connecting VRV18E1 compressor units to fan coil units (MRMAXI18i/MRMAXI30i) and touch screen interfaces, plus a set of detail insets on the right side showing individual connection close-ups.

Overall structure:
- Left side: Two main switchboards (Port, top; Starboard, bottom), each with a 40A breaker (B1, C or D curve) feeding a VRV18E1 Engine Room unit (Port and Starboard respectively). Each VRV18E1 has a ground/anode symbol and connects to a Sea Water Pump (TMD100) via power supply cable, and also feeds into the BUS master line (orange) running along the top of each row.
- Center: Internet Router feeds Ethernet lan to two "Touch Screen 7" nodes (one per system), which connect to "Touch Screen Interface" boxes (Addr.1), then to a chain of fan coil unit controllers along a horizontal BUS Master Line 1 (orange) and 230VAC power line (red) below.
- Port row (top) fan coil chain: Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 (TMD Internet Interface 80W@24VDC) -> MRMAXI18i Fwd Guest cabin Addr.2 (10W@24VDC) -> MRMAXI30i Salon port Addr.3 (90W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI18i Aft Guest cabin port Addr.4 (170W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI30i Fwd Galley Addr.5.0 (90W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI30i Aft Galley Addr.5.1 (170W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI18i Aft Crew cabin port Addr.6 (90W@230VAC) -> AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod.QI-50-V-485 Addr.31 (5W@24VDC) -> TMD Bridge Addr.32 (5W@24VDC) -> RS485 Modbus RTU. Each fan coil node has a "Therm" thermostat block above it linking via BUS S (Slave) lines (pink/magenta) and 230VAC lines below.
- Starboard row (bottom) fan coil chain: Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 (10W@24VDC) -> MRMAXI18i Aft Crew cabin stbd Addr.7 (90W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI18i Fwd Crew cabin stbd Addr.8 (90W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI18i Aft Guest cabin stbd Addr.9 (90W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI30i Salon stbd Addr.10 (170W@230VAC) -> MRMAXI30i Owner's cabin Addr.11 (170W@230VAC) -> AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod.QI-50-V-485 Addr.31 (5W@24VDC) -> TMD Bridge Addr.32 (5W@24VDC) -> RS485 Modbus RTU.
- A "Switch BUS Box Connection" node sits between the two VRV18E1 units (Port/Stbd), linking the Port and Starboard BUS master lines together (magenta/pink BUS Slave line loop connects around both systems).
- Key/legend box (top-left) defines cable types by color: Main Switchboard Compressor Power Supply 230VAC (green, 3x6mm²), Sea Water Pump (red, 3x1.5mm²), Power Supply 230VAC (blue, 3x1.5mm²), Bus Master Line 1 (orange, various core counts), Bus Master Line 2 (brown), Bus Slave Line (magenta/pink), Ethernet Cable UTP Cat.5 (yellow-green), Compressor ground wire (yellow ground symbol, cyan for ground line), with warranty warning note about ground wire connection.
- Top-center box: "BUS CABLE SPECIFICATIONS / NOTES" listing cable section, impedance, capacitance, bus pair shield/screen routing rules, and instructions to enter the PCB using 2x2x0.75mm² wire; "FANCOIL NOTES" box (empty visible content).
- Right side: Six detail inset schematics with their own component-level wiring showing rear-view terminal connections: 
  1. "SyxthSense Touch Screen Connection" - touch screen rear view wiring to Air Handler.
  2. "VRV18E1 Terminal Block Connection" - terminal block wiring detail.
  3. "Syxthsense Touch Screen & SubSlave Air Handler Connection" - SUBSLAVE and SYXTHSENSE TOUCH and Master Air Handler wiring.
  4. "Air Handler Wiring" - detailed Air Handler terminal wiring with Master/Slave connections.
  5. "Air Handler Port and Stbd Connection" - SUBSLAVE, SYXTHSENSE TOUCH, Master Air Handler Saloon Port.
  6. "Air Handler Master and Slave Air Handler Connection" - Master Air Handler / Master Air Handler linked wiring.
  7. "TS7E 7\" Exor Touch Screen & Dual Touch Screen Interfaces Connection" - Master Air Handler Stbd, Touch Screen Interface Compressor Box Nr.1/Nr.2, TMD Internet Interface, Internet Router.
  8. "AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod.QI-50-V-485" - sensor wiring detail with clamp on cable (Max 50A).
  9. "Switch BUS Box Connection" - internal box wiring detail with multiple terminal blocks and circuit breaker/relay.
Title block bottom right: Termodinamica Marine Inverter Air Conditioning, Title: Termodinamica_SW 108-01_Wiring schematic, Sheet 1/1, Rev 0, Rev.0 drawn by N.M., verified by S.P., First Revision, date 28/09/2022.

KEY LINE
MAIN SWITCHBOARD COMPRESSOR POWER SUPPLY230VAC / L+N+PE - 3 x 6 mm²
SEA WATER PUMP / L+N+PE - 3 x 1,5 mm²
POWER SUPPLY 230VAC / L+N+PE - 3 x 1,5 mm²
Compressor ground wire connected to an independent anode / zinc. Ground wire must not be connected to any other device. Warning: failure to comply with this condition will invalidate the system warranty
BUS MASTER LINE 1: 2x2x0,75 mm² - Max. lenght 10m/ <3PCB; 2x1x0,75 mm² + 2x1,5mm² - Max. lenght 20m/ <4PCB; 2x1x0,75 mm² + 2x2,5mm² - Lenght 20-40m / >5+PCB
BUS MASTER LINE 2: same spec pattern
BUS SLAVE LINE: same spec pattern
ETHERNET CABLE UTP CAT. 5

BUS CABLE SPECIFICATIONS / NOTES
SECTION - Min. 0.5 mm² / Max 1.0 mm²
IMPEDANCE - 100 / 120 ohm
CAPACITANCE CONDUCTOR / CONDUCTOR - 50-60 pF / m or less
BUS PAIR - Twisted pair about 10 twist / meter
SHIELD/SCREEN - Connected to GND only to the compressor box side; Screen must be connected everywhere, beetween one cable and another one, but not to the Air handler electronic panel.
ROUTING - Separate from other AC and DC wires, with minimum 10 cm of distance. Use a sheath, to route the cables its highly preferred.
TERMODINAMICA DC POWER SUPPLY CABLE (24VDC ,GND) - Run together as a single line. This lines must come from the compressor unit or from a single point. The power supply from different sources, is not allowed.
TO ENTER THE PCB (AIR HANDLER ELECTRONIC PANEL) USE ANYTIME THE WIRE 2x2x0.75mm².
